name: Wear them down
engine: Tire their defence with every run and press, then beat tired men with less: a clean win needs 3, not 4.
about: Oyarzabal harries their defence: while his own legs are good, every duel he takes costs the man he runs at 8 stamina, and each run with the ball costs them 6 more (Run them ragged). Rodri, as captain, repeats one of those taxes each moment. Once their defence is under 40 stamina it is fatigued: your clean wins against it need a margin of 3, not 4, and what their defenders learned against Yamal stops counting. From the 55th minute, Torres comes on for Oyarzabal: the fatigue stays with their defence, his fresh legs cost them 10 more, and he is +1 for every 20 stamina they have lost.
decisions: Early on, run at them even when a pass has better odds: the stamina they lose is what the rest of the build spends.
Keep going at the defender who has learned Yamal's move: he is +2 against it, but each time costs his line 8 stamina, and once his line is fatigued his learning is gone.
Bring Torres on for Oyarzabal once their defence is tired: Oyarzabal's tax stops when your attack drops under 50 stamina anyway, and the fatigue he made stays.
